scope: Separate changing a base from adding a new route block

browser.environment: In-app browser viewport overrides, not physical phone hardware
checks: Cancel leaves five existing route blocks and Box settings unchanged
Add Shower appends block 6 with one pass selector
Change block 6 to Double Box keeps block count, position and repeat count 2
Double Box exposes four pass selectors
Choosing the already selected Double Box retains independent pass choices
Escape cancels add dialog and restores focus to Add button
Test block restored after reload and removed using route UI
320px cards retain full content height and have no horizontal overflow
Cancel remains within viewport at 320x568 and 844x390
Desktop dialog is centered and contained in 1280x800 viewport

compatibility: Saved route schema and movement generation unchanged
